name: God Helmet double session, part 2 of 2 (same session, 90 min later)
origin: Todd Murphy (2018 interview; he cites one unpublished laboratory trial); base session from his Shiva God Helmet software
summary: Second run of Murphy's 'double session': the identical 40-min God Helmet session (chirp over the right temporal lobe, then the amygdala signal over both sides), started 90 minutes after part 1 ended. Murphy (2018) reports that in one unpublished laboratory trial of this design the EEG response to the second session was 'three times more robust than one session would have been alone'.
setting: Same room, posture and intensity as part 1: darkness and acoustic silence, eyes closed or blindfolded; relax without meditating or falling asleep. A helper can press Skip if phase 1 brings fear.
schedule: Only after part 1, with a 90-minute rest ('wait 90 minutes') and no stimulation in between. Count both parts as one session and leave at least 7 days before the next God Helmet session (Murphy's 2013 advanced procedure: at most once a week, altered-state sessions only).
notes: This part is identical to part 1 and to murphy-gh-chirpr-amybi-40min; the 90-minute rest between the two runs cannot sit inside a program (60-min limit). Murphy (2018 interview, at 58:17): 'wait 90 minutes and then do the exact same session again'; he reports that in one laboratory trial of this design the EEG response to the second session was 'three times more robust' (unpublished; no paper found). Do not run part 2 if part 1 brought anger or irritability (Murphy: never reuse this session then), fear that has not settled, or if you feel unwell. Phase 1 (20 min): the chirp on the four right coils only, 'somewhat unpleasant for many people' (Murphy); press Skip to go to phase 2 and don't make it an endurance contest. Phase 2 (20 min, abrupt switch): amygdala burst-firing on all eight coils. Not for people prone to anxiety, or with epilepsy, migraine, brain injury, a psychiatric diagnosis or medication; no drugs or other mind machines; stop on any distress. Running the session twice in one evening breaks Murphy's God Helmet rule of no more than one session a week (his Shakti rule is one every 72 hours) unless the pair counts as one session. His 2013 'advanced procedure' for Shakti, which may or may not be the same thing (an inference from the matching 'three times' claims), had only been tried for altered states, was not to be used more than once a week, needed no extra hardware or software, and was released only to applicants who agreed on the application form not to disclose its details, waived all claims to damages, stated that they had no psychiatric issues, and agreed not to repeat it after negative effects without contacting tech support; his Shakti software demo says it 'appears to make these sessions three times more effective'. A different two-session use: in the Paranormal State episode 'Lady Vampire' (aired January 2009) an investigator 'did two sessions with a 90-minute interval between them' with the Shakti amygdala signal 'over the front-end of the temporal lobes' (Murphy's page). Approximations (as in part 1): the proprietary 'modulated 40 Hz chirp' is approximated by a decelerating 40 to 6 Hz sweep in 3-ms points (2.5 s on, 1.5 s off; the 40 Hz modulation is not reproduced) and the amygdala 'burstx' template by the built-in accelerating burst (230 points of 3 ms, then 4 s of silence); 62.5 ms per coil (4 cycles per second on each side) stands in for the unpublished step time (Murphy: 'several times per second'); 'clockwise over the left, counter-clockwise over the right' is read with each side seen from its own side, as Murphy's God Helmet animations show (top, back, bottom, front on both sides); phase 2 runs at 0.71 of phase 1 because the software's phase-1 boost of '10%' is read as ten percentage points (35% against 25% at the default; 82% maximum setting + 10 = the 92% ceiling), with the default at 1.4 µT so that phase 2 stays near 1 µT. Independent double-blind tests found no effect of the fields (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012). Revised Oct 2026 after a re-check of the sources: Murphy's own words with the interview timestamp, the conditions of the 2013 procedure (altered states only, at most weekly, no extra hardware or software), the Shakti demo's 'three times' remark and the Paranormal State precedent were added, and the God Helmet weekly rule was stated more exactly. The program was then synced to the revised murphy-gh-chirpr-amybi-40min (4 cycles per second instead of 2, phase 2 at 0.71 instead of 0.91 of phase 1, default 1.4 µT instead of 1 µT) and is again identical to it and to part 1.
